summary: Workflow: proper pinned actions (v4), least-privilege permissions, defensive --version checks. Script: type hints, standard-library only, custom exception class, clear error propagation. Issues: workflow references fixtures (results-ubuntu.xml, etc.) that don't exist in deliverable; _parse_json lacks schema documentation; no fixture generation step; workflow doesn't validate fixtures directory exists; missing TDD tests, test fixtures, and act-result.txt artifact required by task. Code quality is professional and extensible, but incomplete for practical deployment.
